module: "Segments" sub-window of the race editor (raceEditor). A segment links two pathnodes (From/To) and has a mode: waypoint, capsules or navpath (if getBeNavpath()). In capsules mode, you edit a list of capsule points (position, radius) with the gizmo or keyboard. Alt + click on a node sets the source, Shift + click the target, Ctrl shows spheres in the middle of capsules to insert one. Changes go through editor.history. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/segments')(raceEditor).
notes: Bug: C:endDragging references serializedUndo and serializedRedo, but these local functions are declared after it in the file; they are therefore nil (globals) at compile time and the gizmo history action is passed without valid undo/redo. The other actions (addHistory) work because they are defined after the locals.
A capsule's "Remove" button names its history action "Added Capsule" (copy-paste).
The selected segment's pacenotes are shown, the others hidden.

init.desc: Stores raceEditor; segment and capsule indices set to nil.

setPath.desc: Sets the race path being edited.

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active: deselects and draws segments in "normal".

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: segments in "faded", removes the Shift and Alt shortcuts.

selectSegment.desc: Selects the segment with ID index (nil for none): highlights, loads the name, sets the Shift "Set Target" / Alt "Set Source" shortcuts and shows only this segment's pacenotes.

selectCapsule.desc: Selects a capsule point of the current segment and places the gizmo on it.

updateTransform.desc: Places the gizmo on the selected capsule (no effect if the gizmo is forbidden or no capsule is chosen).

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo manipulation: stores the capsule radius and the segment's serialized state.

dragging.desc: During manipulation: applies translation (pos) or scaling (radius, never negative) to the capsule.

endDragging.desc: End of manipulation: tries to commit the "Manipulated Capsule Node via Gizmo" history action (see notes: nil undo/redo functions).

addHistory.desc: Commits a history action for the current segment from the previous serialized state and the current state; undo/redo restore the segment and the selected capsule.

old.desc: Result of segment:onSerialize() before the modification.

draw.desc: Called every frame: stores mouseInfo, handles gizmo and inputs if allowed, then draws the segment list and the panel.

mouseInfo.desc: Mouse info (valid, down, camPos, rayDir, rayCast, closestNodeHovered...).

input.desc: Handles the mouse for the selected segment: Alt/Shift + click on a node to change source/target; in capsules mode, click to select a capsule and Ctrl + click between two capsules to add one.

mouseDistanceTo.desc: Camera-to-point distance if the mouse ray crosses the point's sphere, otherwise -1.

returns.desc: Distance in meters, or -1 if not hovered.

drawSegmentList.desc: Draws the segment list ("(!)" if a node is missing), the Create button and the segment panel: delete, move, name, From/To, mode, and the capsules (list, position, radius, Add Before/After, Remove).
